description: Pakistan International Container Terminal Limited operates a container terminal at Karachi Port and, according to the company, is the only port operator in the country listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It is a member of the ICTSI Group, the Philippines-incorporated global port operator. PICT was granted a 21-year build, operate and transfer contract by the Karachi Port Trust for the construction, development, operation and management of a common-user terminal at Karachi Port, running from 18 June 2002 to 17 June 2023; during that concession the terminal had an annual handling capacity of more than 750,000 TEUs and was equipped with six ship-to-shore cranes.
headOffice: D-36, Block-2, Clifton, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
